result:
Done. Summary of the e2e phase:

**Added** (no application file touched — only `package.json` devDeps + a `test:e2e` script, which TASK.md allows):
- `playwright.config.ts` — chromium, `baseURL` from `APP_URL`/port 4200, `webServer: npm run start` with `reuseExistingServer`, `retries: CI ? 1 : 0`, `trace: retain-on-failure`
- `e2e/support/api.ts` — CORS-aware `page.route` fake of the tutorials REST API (the Express backend at `localhost:5001` isn't running in CI). It records requests *and* server-side state, so tests assert persisted results rather than "a mock was called"
- 5 specs: `tutorials-list`, `add-tutorial`, `tutorial-drawer`, `tutorial-edit`, `accessibility`
- `.test-gen/plan/e2e.md`, `.test-gen/outputs/03-e2e.json`

**Results (two consecutive runs, identical): 30 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped, no flakes.**

The 4 skipped are the axe smoke checks, marked `test.fixme` with `KNOWN-DEFECT` comments because they genuinely fail against the app — not loosened:
- `listitem` (serious): header nav puts `<li>` directly in a `<div>`, no `<ul>` — every page
- `color-contrast` (serious): `.app-footer-note`, `.tm-subtitle`, `.badge-primary` below 4.5:1

Three further app defects found and reported, each pinned by a passing test that documents current behaviour so a fix will make it fail:
- a failed `GET /tutorials` renders the cheerful "No tutorials yet" empty state — users are told they have no data when the server is down
- the add form posts `{title:"", description:""}` and reports success despite `required` inputs
- rejected update/create give the user no feedback at all (errors go only to `console.error`)

tool_input.command: cat package.json && ls && echo "---APP_URL=$APP_URL" && ls e2e 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@axe-core 2>/dev/null
cat package.json && ls && printenv | grep -i -E 'app_url|port' ; ls e2e 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@playwright node_modules/@axe-core 2>/dev/null
cat package.json; ls; env | grep -iE 'app_url|port'; ls e2e node_modules/@playwright node_modules/@axe-core 2>&1 | head -30
env | grep -iE 'app_url|APP_PORT|CI=' ; echo "---"; cat src/app/app-routing.module.ts; echo "---"; ls src/app/components/*

for f in src/app/services/tutorial.service.ts src/app/models/tutorial.model.ts src/app/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts src/app/app.component.html src/app/components/header/header.component.html; do echo "===== $f"; cat "$f"; done

sed -i "s/^  test('the open details drawer/  test.fixme('the open details drawer/; s/^  test('the add tutorial page/  test.fixme('the add tutorial page/; s/^  test('the edit tutorial page/  test.fixme('the edit tutorial page/" e2e/accessibility.spec.ts && grep -n "test.fixme" e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
